svg.title: Route Planning — Planner Choice, Route Evaluation, and Simulation

g.text: Route Planning — Planner Choice, Route Evaluation, and Simulation
relax edges using selected path cost
it does not reserve other trains' routes.
order by departure time, then name
whole-fleet dry-run cost + supplied event risk
try alternatives forbidding one route rail
of at least 1 second. Event risk is
replan train A with rail forbidden
replan train B with rail forbidden
Keep the best conflict-free result, otherwise
fall back to the prioritized solution.
assign paths and create TrainState records
switch only if fleet cost improves
and own gain is at least 30 s
find constrained detour from next station
replay stay vs. detour; switch only
if detour saves more than 30 s
